subject: On‑prem onboarding: network inventory & handoff
messages:
From: Sylvia Ramos <sylvia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 05 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On‑prem deployment intake & network inventory request

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to kick off the on‑prem deployment for Acme Health’s inference workload (tenant: ACME-Prod). Before we schedule the handoff call with our network and security teams, can you confirm the items you need from us so we can gather them?

Quick context: planned region is our primary datacenter in Dallas; we expect an initial capacity for 8 concurrent GPU workers and strict egress controls. Specific asks from our side right now:
- Network diagram template (vlan/subnet/CIDR expectations)
- Required firewall/allowlist ports and IP ranges
- Service account / workload identity guidance and any required key rotation cadence
- KMS/HSM compatibility notes for customer‑managed keys
- Evidence for SOC2 controls around logging/retention (if available)

Can you send over a short checklist and a network inventory template we can fill out? Would like to have this filled before our architecture call on Thursday (9/9).

Thanks,
Sylvia Ramos
Director, Platform Ops — Acme Health
attachments: none
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Sylvia Ramos <sylvia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem deployment intake & network inventory request

Hi Sylvia —

Great to connect yesterday. I’ve attached a concise onboarding checklist plus a network inventory template we use to validate on‑prem activations. Attached: redwood_onprem_onboarding_prereqs_v1.pdf and acme_network_inventory_template.xlsx.

Summary of what we need from Acme before the architecture call:
1) Completed network inventory (template) — VLANs, CIDRs, peering details, NAT/egress gateways
2) Service account emails and owner; list any restricted scopes or role mappings
3) KMS/bring‑your‑own‑key plan: provider, key rotation, and whether HSM is required
4) Evidence links for SOC2 / control summaries (even artifact pointers are fine)
5) Point of contact for switch level changes and firewall rule submissions

Proposed next steps:
- Fill template and send back by EOD Wednesday (9/8)
- 60‑minute architecture call Thursday 9/9 at 10:00am CDT — please confirm attendees

Operational notes / constraints we’ll validate on the call:
- We recommend a pair of /29 for our control plane egress (two adjacent host ranges) for HA.
- Persistent outbound TLS to our telemetry endpoints must be allowed for metrics/logging; we can accept proxy egress under your NAT.
- If you require HSM for model keys, we’ll need the PKCS#11 interface details in advance.

I’m copying Ben (network) and Marissa (customer success) to align on scheduling and the checklist.

—
Irene Choi
Solutions Architect, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
irsig@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0123
attachments: redwood_onprem_onboarding_prereqs_v1.pdf, acme_network_inventory_template.xlsx

Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 10:17:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem deployment intake & network inventory request

Thanks Irene — received and we’ll populate the inventory. Two quick clarifications before the call:

1) SOC2 evidence: we have a SOC2 summary report and a separate section on logging/retention. I can share the pointer after I confirm with compliance (not the full report). Is a summary doc sufficient for your preflight?
2) KMS: we plan to use HashiCorp Vault behind our HSM provider. We do require customer‑managed keys and hardware protection on keys used to wrap model artifacts. Will Redwood accept a Vault PKCS#11 bridge or do you need direct HSM integration?

Also — we have an internal change freeze window next Friday (9/10). If anything requires network firewall changes that day, we’ll need to schedule an exception. Our target is to complete all validations before the freeze.

Can confirm architecture call for Thursday 9/9 at 10:00am CDT — attendees will be myself, our NetOps lead (Jason Lee), and our Security manager (Priya Shah).

Sylvia

- Karthik: please pre‑review the network inventory template and flag any non‑standard port or routing asks. Priority: NAT/egress design and inter‑site peering assumptions.
- Ben: be prepared to discuss our recommended control plane IP ranges and HA egress model; confirm if /29 pair is OK for their setup.
- Marissa: own the call agenda and confirm that we have the SOC2 summary language ready to share.

I’ve attached a one‑page preflight doc (redwood_onprem_onboarding_prereqs_v1.pdf) — aim to have internal notes added to the Jira ticket PL‑4249 before 9/9 09:00 CDT.

If either of you sees blockers (HSM integration or a long lead on firewall exceptions), flag immediately so we can request the freeze exception window.
